name: Dingpot

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours. Familiar block (CR 1). Bond ritual: 10 minutes with materials worth 100+ gp (spices and rose quartz); the Familiar Bond rules (bonded sympathy, channel magic, telepathic connection, 1-hour revival) are on page 580 and are listed once in the notes file.

traits.name: Boil and Bubble
traits.summary: While not Incapacitated, can heat water in its pot to boiling.
traits.text: While the dingpot isn't Incapacitated, it can warm the water in its vessel to a boil.

actions.name: Steam Spray
actions.summary: +4, range 60, 2d4+2 Fire (water gives no Resistance); the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the dingpot's next turn.

actions.name: Brew
actions.summary: Once a day: makes an elixir that keeps 24 hours, either a Healing Draught (Bonus Action to drink: 1d6+1 Hit Points) or a Lucky Draught (Bonus Action to drink: for 10 minutes reroll one failed ability check or save; it ends once a reroll succeeds).
actions.text: The dingpot brews one magical elixir in its vessel, potent for 24 hours. Healing Draught: a creature that drinks it as a Bonus Action regains 4 (1d6 + 1) Hit Points. Lucky Draught: a creature that drinks it as a Bonus Action gains luck for 10 minutes; when it fails an ability check or saving throw it may reroll the d20 and use the new roll, and once that makes a roll succeed the effect ends.

summary: A cheerful floating cauldron that scalds with steam and brews a daily healing or luck potion.
